newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - MERITA UPS ENSO TO OUTPERFORM.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MERITA UPS ENSO TO OUTPERFORM.

text.p: Merita Securities on Wednesday upgraded Finnish forest industry group Enso to outperform from neutral after Enso's H1 results, analyst Pertti Aaltonen said.
He said Merita would raise its existing 1997 and 1998 estimates for Enso but did not specify forecasts and declined to give a target price.
Aaltonen said the outlook for fine paper prices was positive, although he saw some uncertainty factors.
"Time will show how 1998 will be -- the recommendations are based especially on the year 1999, which seems good," he said.
